resources.string: Eye-gaze page turn
Look up to turn

When enabled, the front camera tracks your gaze. Frames are processed only on this device and are never saved or uploaded.

On first use, keep the room well lit and hold the phone and your head steady, then look at the dots at the top, bottom and center as prompted. The calibration is saved only after the center check passes, so later sessions need no recalibration. Older two-point calibrations must be redone once.

Read naturally to the bottom of the screen, pause briefly, and when "Look up to turn" appears at the page footer, move your gaze upward to go to the next page. Blinking or lifting your head alone will not trigger a turn.

Leaving the reader or going to the background turns eye-gaze paging off; re-enable it manually each time you return. Accuracy depends on lighting, glasses glare and how you hold the phone, so try to keep the same posture as during calibration.

If accuracy is poor, use "Settings → Other settings → Recalibrate eye-gaze paging" and then re-enable the feature to calibrate again.
